heroHeadline: Germany Closes Russia's Last Consulate as Romanian Border Towns Report Record Drone Fear
heroSubtitle: Russia's Consulate General in Bonn — the last of five it operated in Germany — reached its September 18 closure deadline, the culmination of Berlin's response to its September 1 attribution of the Leipzig/Halle Airport drone plot to Russia; Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul and EU foreign-policy chief Kaja Kallas cited the plot's 'hallmarks of state-sponsored terrorism,' while Russian Ambassador Sergey Nechayev called the closure 'unprecedented' and 'unfriendly.' Separately, AP reporting from the Romanian border town of Isaccea on September 17 detailed residents living in 'terror' amid a near-tripling of confirmed drone incursions this year — 27 versus 9 in all of 2025, per Romania's Defence Ministry — alongside 73 Russian strikes near the border (vs 28 in 2025) and 56 aircraft scrambles (vs 21). Poland separately renewed its low-altitude no-fly zone along the Ukraine and Belarus borders through December 9.
footerNote: Data sourced from official NATO/SHAPE and member-state defense ministry statements, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
